gravity._comment: Stages with "physics": "gravity". collect = grains pulled into one block per second; fall = cells a grain falls per second (one simulation step per cell).

suction._comment: Rule B-2, stages with "collect": "suction". Distances are in cells of the 128x128 sand grid (1 cell = 1 grain), scaled by width/128 at other resolutions. link: same-color grains chain when max(|dx|,|dy|) <= link. reach: only grains within this Euclidean distance of the block's nearest intake cell. finish_at: fraction of capacity that starts the finish pull of all remaining same-color grains (0 = off). collect_per_second: grains taken per second per block (finish: x finish_speed_scale). scan_visits_per_frame: cell checks per frame for the target search; larger scans continue next frame.

suction_fx._comment: Suction animation only (does not change collection). Flight time = distance / speed, clamped; finish pulls fly finish_speed_scale times faster.
